# photo-led v14 regression fixture

Provenance: `photo-led-5v-20261026`, page `cd008f919db36eba` (P1), official
EasyEDA Pro 4.1.78 SVG export + `sch list` read on 2026-10-26.  The source
project is the real v14 after the schematic relayout; this fixture is a trimmed
adapter input, not a synthetic design and not an acceptance claim for the
project.

Files:

- `list.json`: `sch list --include-bbox --include-pins --include-wires
  --include-page-primitives`, trimmed to the fields the adapter consumes
  (components/pins/otherProperty, page texts/wires/rectangles).  The 1072
  page attributes are omitted; they are not needed by `layout_from_easyeda.py`.
- `rendered-text.json`: `svg_text_bbox.py` measurement of all 136 rendered
  `<text>` elements (bbox y is SVG-style negative; the adapter flips it once).
- `sheet.json`: `easyeda sch sheet-geometry --from-svg` result (offline).
- `layout.json` / `checker-expected.json`: adapter and strict checker output
  generated by this branch.  They are kept for diff review; the test recomputes
  both.

Expected real residuals (not adapter false positives):

1. `bbox_overlap R3 body × R3 '10kΩ'`: the value text anchors at y=348 and
   renders 348–358, touching the body top at 355.5 by 2.5 raw.  A single
   attribute move (anchor y=338) clears it without touching wires.
2. `wire_enters_bbox` ×2: the zone-2 purpose text bbox is 759.5–771.5 and the
   VREF stub runs at y=760.  Recreate the purpose text at y=772 (free-text move
   is not persistent) or move that stub to y=755.

Hint-only findings: `different_named_wires_cross` and `text_wire_clearance`
carry `severity=info` and `category=readability_hint`.  Label/own-wire contact
is exempted through `anchor_id` → `primitive_id`; a foreign wire crossing the
same glyphs is still reported.
